title: Vet agent roles
description: Which agents do what in a /vet run. Optional file evals/agents.json sets repo-wide defaults; --preset and --agent role.key=value override it for one run. A preset fills in batch for each judge role; anything set explicitly wins.

preset.description: thorough: grade per run, compare per item, cross per item. lean (default): grade per prompt, compare per prompt, cross in one judge. minimal: one judge per prompt grades and compares, cross in one judge.

run.description: Executes the skill. Changing its model changes what is being tested, not just the cost. Takes no batch.

grade.description: Rubric judge. batch run: one judge per run. batch prompt: one judge grades every run of a prompt.

compare.description: Similarity across repeats of one prompt. batch item: one judge per (prompt, rubric item). batch prompt: one judge per prompt compares every item. batch merged: the per-prompt grade judge also compares (forces grade.batch prompt).

cross.description: Structure across different prompts. batch item: one judge per structure item. batch all: one judge for all of them.

model.description: "session" (default) inherits the session's model; otherwise an alias such as "sonnet" or "haiku", or a full model id.

agentType.description: A custom subagent type from the same registry as the Agent tool.
